title: Short-Term Rental Pricing & Occupancy Forecasting

blueprintSignals.name: Event calendar
blueprintSignals.definition: number and size of events within 5 km in the stay window
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Event data are patchy, so combine providers

blueprintSignals.name: Booking pace
blueprintSignals.definition: bookings so far divided by the normal bookings for this lead time
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Noisy for new listings, so use a prior

blueprintSignals.name: Comparable prices
blueprintSignals.definition: median nightly price of comparable listings for the same date
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Selection bias, since only unsold nights show prices

blueprintSignals.name: Review score
blueprintSignals.definition: average rating over the last 12 months with a minimum count
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Ratings are inflated, so use relative rank

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin
values on the same weekday in previous weeks
what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin
promotion and external-signal flags for the target day, as published at the origin
how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "Short-Term Rental Pricing & Occupancy Forecasting": Recommend nightly prices and forecast occupancy for short-term rentals around events and seasons. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Past prices are partly caused by the hosts' own expectations, so demand and price are tangled.
